title: Knowledge-to-Technology Conversion Engine - Technology Profile
description: Public edition: Transforms scientific papers, datasets, equations, designs, and patents into testable engineering plans and usable software.
body:
Knowledge-to-Technology Conversion Engine. Transforms scientific papers, datasets, equations, designs, and patents into testable engineering plans and usable software.

This database covers the technology as item 211 entry 35 of Manon's "100 Ultra-Advanced Future Technologies" catalog, section "Intelligence Beyond Today's AI". It is the public edition: every factual claim below is drawn from real public science and engineering, honestly labeled.

Feasibility tier: experimentally supported. Paper-to-code and literature-mining systems work in narrow slices; general conversion to engineering plans is unproven.

Classification: public database. This record profiles the technology; companion records cover known science, constraints, approaches, tools, unresolved problems, evidence, and outlook.

title: Knowledge-to-Technology Conversion Engine - Known Science Foundations
description: Public edition: Transforms scientific papers, datasets, equations, designs, and patents into testable engineering plans and usable software.
body:
Known science foundations of Knowledge-to-Technology Conversion Engine.

Paper-to-code agents reproduce ML results from papers. Patent-mining extracts technical disclosures. Materials and drug pipelines convert literature into candidates (e.g., retrosynthesis from reaction databases). General conversion of arbitrary scientific knowledge into tested engineering plans remains aspirational.

Key quantity check (Papers published per year / papers with reproducible artifacts): computed ratio 20 against the reference value, relative error 0, within the stated tolerance of 0.3. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.

title: Knowledge-to-Technology Conversion Engine - Physical and Engineering Constraints
description: Public edition: Transforms scientific papers, datasets, equations, designs, and patents into testable engineering plans and usable software.
body:
Physical and engineering constraints on Knowledge-to-Technology Conversion Engine.

Papers omit the tacit knowledge needed to reproduce results. Most published findings do not replicate cleanly. Engineering plans need constraints papers never state.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 7.3 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is papers per year vs conversion success rate at 7.3 orders of magnitude (papers per year larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.

title: Knowledge-to-Technology Conversion Engine - Unresolved Problems
description: Public edition: Transforms scientific papers, datasets, equations, designs, and patents into testable engineering plans and usable software.
body:
Unresolved problems for Knowledge-to-Technology Conversion Engine, in priority order (research burden index 30, 3 blocking):

Extracting tacit knowledge (severity 3/3, tractability 1/3, BLOCKING; priority 12).

Handling irreproducible literature (severity 3/3, tractability 2/3, BLOCKING; priority 9).

From plan to working artifact (severity 3/3, tractability 2/3, BLOCKING; priority 9).

These are open problems, stated plainly. A technology with unresolved blocking problems is not ready, whatever its promise.
